name: fusion360-mcp
description: MCP server for Fusion 360 automation via its API. Provides sketch, feature, drawing, sheet metal, dimension, and analysis tools for voice-driven CAD interaction.

tools.name: create_line
tools.description: Create a line segment in the active sketch

tools.name: create_circle
tools.description: Create a circle in the active sketch

tools.name: create_arc
tools.description: Create an arc in the active sketch

tools.name: create_rectangle
tools.description: Create a rectangle in the active sketch

tools.name: create_spline
tools.description: Create a spline curve in the active sketch

tools.name: create_center_point
tools.description: Create a center point in the active sketch

tools.name: add_dimension
tools.description: Add a dimension constraint to a sketch entity

tools.name: add_constraint
tools.description: Add a geometric constraint between entities

tools.name: extrude
tools.description: Create an extrusion feature (new body or cut)

tools.name: revolve
tools.description: Create a revolve feature from a profile and axis

tools.name: sweep
tools.description: Create a sweep feature along a path

tools.name: loft
tools.description: Create a loft feature between profiles

tools.name: fillet
tools.description: Apply a fillet to selected edges or faces

tools.name: chamfer
tools.description: Apply a chamfer to selected edges

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Create a hollow shell by removing faces

tools.name: pattern_rectangular
tools.description: Create a rectangular pattern of features

tools.name: pattern_circular
tools.description: Create a circular pattern of features

tools.name: mirror
tools.description: Mirror features across a plane

tools.name: hole
tools.description: Create a hole feature with standard types

tools.name: combine
tools.description: Combine bodies via join, cut, or intersect

tools.name: split_body
tools.description: Split a body using a tool or plane

tools.name: thicken
tools.description: Thicken a surface body to a solid

tools.name: create_drawing
tools.description: Create a 2D drawing from a design

tools.name: add_dimension_to_view
tools.description: Add dimensions to a drawing view

tools.name: create_flange
tools.description: Create a sheet metal flange from an edge

tools.name: create_fold
tools.description: Create a fold feature in sheet metal

tools.name: unfold
tools.description: Unfold a sheet metal part for flat pattern

tools.name: create_bend
tools.description: Create a bend in a sheet metal part

tools.name: measure_distance
tools.description: Measure distance between two points or entities

tools.name: measure_angle
tools.description: Measure angle between two entities

tools.name: analyze_stress
tools.description: Run a stress analysis simulation

tools.name: analyze_modal
tools.description: Run a modal frequency analysis

tools.name: get_physical_properties
tools.description: Get physical properties (mass, volume, center of gravity)

tools.name: export_step
tools.description: Export the active design to STEP format

tools.name: export_iges
tools.description: Export the active design to IGES format

tools.name: export_stl
tools.description: Export the active design to STL for 3D printing
